reviewNotes: Held back: the page gives no year for the tune; the score has a bar of another length (bar 12), which the solfa grid does not draw. Imported from CCEH tune 000343 (the melody read from 000343a.mid, checked against the page's do-re-mi incipit, 2 notes off in 28); check the notes and the bar lines against a hymn book you trust, then set "reviewed": true. The bar lines are those of CCEH's Noteworthy score (000343a.nwc). The tune ends on E, neither doh nor lah: it may be modal; the doh is the key signature's.
